reasons.adk-output-overcount: Google ADK adds the reasoning count to an output count that already includes it
reasons.agno-openinference-no-reasoning: OpenInference's Agno instrumentation sends no reasoning count
reasons.claude-code-retries: Claude Code logs one event per failed query, not one per failed request
reasons.claude-code-side-call: Claude Code logs no event for an internal side call (Python Agent SDK run)
reasons.crewai-no-call-span: CrewAI with OpenInference or OpenLLMetry emits no model-call span (run totals only)
reasons.datadog-anthropic-no-reasoning: Datadog's tracers send no reasoning count on the Anthropic path
reasons.laminar-anthropic-no-reasoning: Laminar sends no reasoning count on the Anthropic path
reasons.langchain-separate-traces: A LangChain instrumentation span and a provider-level span of one call land in separate traces without a shared answer id: the call counts twice
reasons.langsmith-failure-as-ok: LangSmith's OTLP mode exports a failed call with status OK (the error is a span event)
reasons.langsmith-js-no-call-span: LangSmith's OTLP mode exports no model-call spans in JavaScript
reasons.llamaindex-openllmetry-error-no-span: LlamaIndex with OpenLLMetry leaves no span for a failed call
reasons.llamaindex-openllmetry-no-reasoning: LlamaIndex with OpenLLMetry sends no reasoning count
reasons.mlflow-stream-not-traced: MLflow does not trace Anthropic's messages.stream()
reasons.openai-agents-anthropic-stream-no-usage: The OpenAI Agents SDK's spans carry no usage for a streamed call on the Anthropic path
reasons.openai-agents-js-separate-roots: OpenAI Agents SDK (JavaScript) with a provider instrumentation: the provider span is a separate root, the call counts twice
reasons.openai-agents-openinference-no-cache-rea: OpenInference's OpenAI Agents instrumentation sends no cache-read or reasoning count
reasons.openai-agents-openllmetry-no-tokens: OpenLLMetry's OpenAI Agents instrumentation sends no token counts
reasons.openllmetry-js-error-no-span: OpenLLMetry (JavaScript) sends no span for a failed OpenAI call
reasons.openllmetry-js-no-cache-reasoning: OpenLLMetry (JavaScript) sends no cache-read or reasoning count
reasons.openllmetry-js-stream-no-usage: OpenLLMetry (JavaScript) sends no usage for an OpenAI stream
reasons.openllmetry-langchain-no-cache-reasoning: OpenLLMetry's LangChain instrumentation sends no reasoning count (JavaScript: no cache-read count either)
reasons.openllmetry-py-stream-no-reasoning: OpenLLMetry (Python) sends no reasoning count on OpenAI streams
reasons.otel-openai-no-cache-reasoning: OpenTelemetry's OpenAI instrumentation (openai-v2, JavaScript, EDOT) sends no cache-read or reasoning count
reasons.parallel-failures-paired-by-time: A failed call seen by the Anthropic SDK's own span and by a wrapper's span in two traces is paired by time; among parallel failures some pairs are missed and count twice
reasons.pydantic-ai-rejected-attempts: OpenTelemetry's Anthropic instrumentation emits failed call spans for attempts rejected before any request
reasons.sdk-retry-one-call: An SDK retries a failed request inside one call: Netdata counts the call once, as it ended, while the API saw every attempt
reasons.vercel-no-reasoning: The Vercel AI SDK sends no reasoning count
